scope: Anonymized summaries projected from preserved decisions, dispatch events, results, reviews and best records. Order is historical; playback is illustrative, not original elapsed time. No original quote or terminal log is simulated.

nodes.title: Two candidates
nodes.summary: A — clearer instructions: an explicit evidence-state contract. B — computed facts: deterministic facts supplied to both arms, to evaluate assisted reporting.

nodes.title: Choose A: clearer instructions
nodes.summary: The researcher selected the prompt-only change to target unsupported significance claims. Computed facts were reserved for persistent failures because they change the assistance given to the model.

nodes.title: Dispatch the first batch
nodes.summary: A real frozen six-test comparison was dispatched: six baseline and six selected requests, 12 model requests in total.

nodes.title: First result: 4/6 versus 4/6
nodes.summary: Baseline and selected each passed 4/6 objective checks and 4/6 independent explanation reviews.

nodes.title: Review found contradictions
nodes.summary: Structured winner, numeric units and rejection labels disagreed with the explanations. A clearer prompt alone had not solved the consistency failures.

nodes.title: An observed best is not an accepted best
nodes.summary: The persisted record retained the baseline as the observed 4/6 result in the first cohort. Neither configuration met acceptance criteria.

nodes.title: Abandon prompt-only sufficiency
nodes.summary: The resumed researcher rejected the sufficiency hypothesis and chose computed facts with an explicit output-mapping contract, using fresh fixtures.

nodes.title: Automatically dispatch the second batch
nodes.summary: The result-driven decision was followed by a real second dispatch. Another 12 requests ran, reaching the bounded total of 24.

nodes.title: Second result: objective 6/6, review 5/6
nodes.summary: Selected passed 6/6 objective checks and 5/6 explanation reviews. Baseline remained 4/6 on both measures. This batch used a different fixture set.

nodes.title: Reject the apparent win
nodes.summary: The controller supplied computed facts only to the selected arm, contrary to the requested equal-input protocol; the audit schema also differed. The higher observed score cannot justify promotion.
nodes.observed_best: Selected: 6/6 objective, 5/6 review (second cohort; invalid intended comparison)

nodes.title: Corrected protocol: model retest not run
nodes.summary: Offline protocol checks passed. A fresh matched-input Qwen evaluation remains the proposed next experiment; no corrected model retest has run.
